7 7 7 3 7 3 7 3 7 3 7 3 7 3 7 3 7
7 7 3 7 3 7 3 7 3 7 3 7 3 7 3 7 3
7 7 7 7 7 7 7 7 7 7 7 7 7 7 7 7 7""".split("\n")]
grid=[list(map(int,r.split())) for r in inp]
assert len(grid)==23 and all(len(r)==17 for r in grid)
def nbr8(r,c):
    return [(r+dr,c+dc) for dr in(-1,0,1) for dc in(-1,0,1) if (dr,dc)!=(0,0) and 0<=r+dr<23 and 0<=c+dc<17]
out=[row[:] for row in grid]
# erase 8-isolated singles
for r in range(23):
    for c in range(17):
        if grid[r][c]==3 and all(grid[nr][nc]!=3 for nr,nc in nbr8(r,c)):
            out[r][c]=7
# extend rightmost run of len>=2 to edge with 1s
for r in range(23):
    row=out[r]
    # find runs of 3
    runs=[];c=0
    while c<17:
        if row[c]==3:
            s=c
            while c<17 and row[c]==3: c+=1
            if c-s>=2: runs.append((s,c-1))
        else: c+=1
    if runs:
        s,e=runs[-1]
        for c in range(e+1,17): row[c]=1
print('\n'.join(' '.join(map(str,row)) for row in out))
